info.description: Public HTTP front for one agent: auth (JWT + EIP-191), bootstrap status, config endpoints, /responses. Authenticated routes proxy to runtime_host on the loopback interface.
info.title: Agentic Agent Node — Gateway Host API

parameters.description: Attributes as a JSON object string
parameters.name: attributes

get.description: Returns a fresh nonce + expiry. The caller signs the nonce with their wallet (EIP-191 personal_sign) and posts the result to /auth/verify.

post.description: Verifies the EIP-191 signature, checks the recovered address against the NFT owner via the worker, and issues a HS256 JWT.

get.description: Liveness probe; serves before bootstrap completes.

post.description: x402 v2 gated: send a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Each caller pays the cheapest accept option whose address patterns match them — zero-price options (agent wallet and NFT owner by default) are served free without settlement. Anonymous 402 responses advertise only the options open to everyone.
